title: AFP foils NPA extortion attempt in Laguna
intro_html:
CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City - The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) prevented the communist terrorist group (CTG) extortion activity in Laguna as soldiers encountered them on Sunday, April 17.

According to Lt. Col. Danilo V Escandor, some concerned citizens reported the presence of the armed group on their farms, extorting for food and money, which prompted the Philippine Army's 1st Infantry Battalion under the 2nd Infantry Division to conduct a security operation to verify the report.
body_html:
"The report turned out to be positive as the operating troops encountered more or less 15 communist NPA terrorists (CNTs) at Sitio Pinagtablahan, Barangay Magsaysay, Siniloan, Laguna on Sunday morning. The firefight lasted for about 15 minutes then the enemy evaded the government forces. The terrorists belong to Platun 2, Kilusang Larang Gerilya Narciso of the Southern Tagalog Regional Party Committee," Lt. Escandor said.

One CNT was killed in the encounter, while no reported casualties on the government forces. The soldiers captured one (1) M16 rifle and three (3) backpacks at the encounter site.

According to the AFP Public Affairs Office Chief Col. Jorry L Baclor, "The AFP and concerned agencies under the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) are addressing the resource generation of the communist terrorist group (CTG) to prevent them from recruiting new members and stopping their recovery efforts."

"Stopping the resource generation of the CTG will expedite the end of the local communist armed conflict in the country," Col Baclor added.
